ablations: Fixed explicit v2 instructions with all original full-context task records retained.
baseline: The same checkpoint, offered requests and inference settings on complete original contexts with cache disabled.
candidate_delta: Keep every original record, key, value, query and order, but replace the compact instruction header with one fixed explicit operand definition, unrelated example and complete-five-letter output instruction. No slicing or cache change.
claim_limit: One fixed development wording diagnosis on identical task records. No prompt search, architecture novelty, LLM training or universal comprehension/efficiency claim. Failed original results remain retained.

evaluation.confirmation: Use a separately seeded confirmation split only after protocol and candidate freeze. Same Unix identity: workflow separation, not malicious-writer isolation.
evaluation.development: Use the development split for implementation and feasibility; retain its complete costs and outputs.
evaluation.selection_rule: One predeclared candidate and causal ablations, equal populations/repetitions/model settings. Do not tune or replace a failed confirmation.

falsifiers: Any retained task semantics lost by the closure certificate refutes its restricted preservation claim.
Actual model accuracy loss despite a valid certificate refutes certificate-to-model-output equivalence.
Startup, analysis, tokenization or retries erasing service savings defeats full-cost improvement.
If a symbolic interpreter suffices, do not frame this task as requiring an LLM or claim broad inference advances.
invariants: Same admitted model, tokenizer/template, output ceiling, sampling, offered task population and paired order.
Candidate consumes prompt text only. Expected answers are independently evaluated after inference.
Every failed, interrupted and missing request remains charged and in the offered denominator.
mechanism: Keep every original record, key, value, query and order, but replace the compact instruction header with one fixed explicit operand definition, unrelated example and complete-five-letter output instruction. No slicing or cache change.

metrics.decision_rule: At least 5% improvement in every balanced pair, with quality gates and at most 10% p95/p99 tail regression; descriptive ranges, not significance.
metrics.name: full_attempt_wall

metrics.decision_rule: Include setup, development/search, failed attempts, preprocessing and retries; shared ancestry is counted once.
metrics.name: all_allocation_cost

metrics.decision_rule: 95% absolute minimum and zero allowed observed pairwise quality regression.
metrics.name: task_accuracy

novelty.search_scope: Known instruction and in-context-example technique; Brown et al. https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.14165 reviewed 2026-09-08. This is a bounded development diagnosis, not novelty or model training.
unresolved_questions: Whether a syntax/dependency certificate predicts model task accuracy or cost advantage on the declared structured-record population.

prediction: A fixed clarification of operand roles and output format may improve model comprehension of the same records; failure would rule out this single wording alternative, not every possible prompt.

prior_art.overlap: Extractive and abstractive compression before language-model inference; existing compression/selection baseline, not a local reproduction.
prior_art.proposed_difference: A small registered record-language closure/certificate/fallback implementation and its real-model causal ablations; no priority claim and no replication of the paper benchmark.

prior_art.overlap: Learned extractive prompt compression via token classification; overlaps the general aim of preserving useful information while shortening prompts.
prior_art.proposed_difference: A small registered record-language closure/certificate/fallback implementation and its real-model causal ablations; no priority claim and no replication of the paper benchmark.

prior_art.overlap: Commitment-level representation, verification and conservative fallbacks; closest recent conceptual overlap, not a guarantee of unchanged model outputs.
prior_art.proposed_difference: A small registered record-language closure/certificate/fallback implementation and its real-model causal ablations; no priority claim and no replication of the paper benchmark.

prior_art.overlap: Learned static slicing with dependency identification and constrained generation; overlaps source-grounded dependency selection, with different model and task scope.
prior_art.proposed_difference: A small registered record-language closure/certificate/fallback implementation and its real-model causal ablations; no priority claim and no replication of the paper benchmark.

quality_contract.decision_rule: Both arms at least 95% correct on every offered request, with no observed pairwise task-quality loss. Same-input controls additionally require exact token parity.
quality_contract.population: Complete prospectively frozen structured workload, model profile, split, seed and offered arrivals in the compiled recipe.
quality_contract.semantic_equivalence: Task-answer equivalence for changed-input interventions; output differences remain visible. Syntax/dependency preservation does not imply unchanged logits or general language quality.

resources.gpu_requirement: None for the current registered CPU control. Future model-stage needs require separate admission.

stop_rules: Respect the accepted recipe allocation and original deadline; do not create a new clock.
Retain failed and interrupted attempts; do not replace a measured same-recipe result.
